cards.text: Friend, it's early on the first day of the week, and it's still dark. Jesus has been laid in a new tomb in a garden, near where He was crucified (John 19:41-42). Mary Magdalene, who stood near His cross (John 19:25), heads out to that tomb.

cards.question: Mary Magdalene reaches the tomb while it's still dark. What does she see at the entrance?

answers.text: The stone is still in place

cards.text: So Mary RUNS in the dark to Simon Peter, one of Jesus' twelve disciples (Matthew 10:2), and to the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. Friend, I can't even find the light switch in my own bakery in the dark.

cards.question: Mary tells Peter and the other disciple that she knows where the Lord's body has been put.

cards.text: Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb, running together. Two grown men in a full sprint, and friend, this is a RACE now.

cards.question: Peter and the other disciple are running together to the tomb. Who gets there first?

cards.text: First place goes to the other disciple, and I respect it, because I hop everywhere on this gold base and I have never won a race in my LIFE. He bends down and looks in at the linen cloths lying there.

cards.question: After looking in at the linen cloths, the other disciple goes right inside the tomb.

cards.text: Then here comes Simon Peter, just after him, and Peter does NOT stop at the door. Second place in the race, first one inside, and he sees the linen cloths lying there.

cards.question: Peter also sees a cloth rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths. It's the cloth that had been around Jesus' ___.

cards.text: Then the other disciple, the one who got there first, goes in too.

cards.question: The other disciple stands inside the tomb and sees it all. How does he respond?
At this point, Peter and the other disciple already understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.

cards.text: Then the disciples return to their homes. Empty tomb, rolled-up cloth, and friend, I'd still be in there interviewing the cloth.
The disciples went home, but Mary is NOT moving. She stands outside the tomb weeping, and as she weeps, she bends down to look inside.

cards.question: Mary Magdalene bends down and looks into the tomb. Who does she see?
The two angels are sitting where Jesus' body had lain, one at the ___ and the other at the ___.

cards.text: The angels ask her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” Two angels in white, friend, and if that were me, I'd have dropped every cookie box in the bakery.

cards.question: The angels ask Mary why she's weeping. What does she tell them?

answers.text: Someone has taken her Lord away
She came too late for the burial
The disciples have left her alone

cards.text: Mary says this, and she turns around. And friend… Jesus is standing right there.

cards.question: Mary recognizes Jesus the moment she turns around and sees Him.

cards.text: Jesus asks her the same question the angels asked: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Then He adds, “Whom are you seeking?”

cards.question: Mary still doesn't know it's Jesus. She thinks He is the ___.

cards.text: She says, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.” Friend, she's ready to go get Him all by HERSELF, and I needed help lifting a full cookie box yesterday.
Then Jesus says just one word. Friend, I use four hundred words just to say good morning, and He needs ONE.

cards.question: Jesus says just one word to Mary. What is it?
Mary turns and says to Jesus in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” which means ___.

cards.text: One word, her name, and she knows Him. Jesus tells her, “Do not cling to Me,” because He has not yet ascended to the Father.

cards.question: Jesus tells Mary not to cling to Him. What does He send her to do?

answers.text: Keep it a secret for now

cards.question: Jesus gives Mary a message for His brothers: He is ascending to His Father and their Father, to His God and their God.

cards.text: So Mary Magdalene heads off to the disciples with an announcement. Friend, whenever I have an announcement, I yell it across the whole bakery, and it's just me and the cookies.

cards.question: Mary Magdalene goes to the disciples with an announcement. What does she tell them?

answers.text: The gardener knows where He is

cards.text: And she tells them what He said to her. Keep your apron on, friend, because this story is still going.

findings.problem: The wrong answer "The disciples have left her alone" is true in the passage: the disciples return to their homes while Mary remains outside the tomb (John 20:10-11). It is not what Mary tells the angels, but a wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not merely false as an answer to this question.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.

findings.problem: Cards 11 and 12 set up Jesus' next word and then ask the baker to guess that exact word. Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason out "Mary" rather than "Peace" or "Rise"; this asks for the next wording of His line instead of the movement or meaning of the passage.

rule.text: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
